title: A NOTE, TAPED UP
body:

title: INTAKE RECORD · S-07
body:
Name: PARTH (surname withheld under programme rules)
Age at intake: 33
Received from: District Jail, 18-month sentence (theft)
Referral: self, in response to a volunteer notice

Programme: NIDRA (trauma-memory attenuation)
Participation: VOLUNTARY
Consent: signed in full, every page

Housing: Cellhouse A · Tier 3 · N03
Work: trusty, Maintenance / Laundry
Projected cycles: 12
footer: Subject's signature: steady.   Witness: Dr. M. Varma, Principal Investigator.

title: OFFICE OF THE WARDEN · INTERNAL
body:
To: Warden S. Sethi
From: Deputy Superintendent (Programmes)
Re: NIDRA, subject S-07

S-07 exceeds the projected cycle count. Recommend protocol termination.

The programme lead declines to close the file on clinical grounds. Funding review is next quarter. Please advise.
footer: In pencil, in the margin: "Ghost Exit, as before. Maintenance tunnels. No paperwork. — S."

title: OFFICE OF THE WARDEN · ORDER
body:
Re: NIDRA, subject S-07

Recommendation of protocol termination: APPROVED.

Remove from Cellhouse A at 02:00 tonight. Escort: Constable Bhosle.
Exit by Maintenance B1. No entry in the movement register.

The programme lead is not to be informed before 02:00.
footer: Signed S. Sethi, Warden. Stamped and dated today.

title: MEDICAL RECORDS · NIDRA SUPPORT
body:
Induction agent: dispensed at the dietary window, 07:00 and 18:00, all NIDRA subjects. Report any missed dose.

Antagonist: JAGRAN (anti-induction). Secure Medicine, trolley, red cap.
One vial before an induction blunts it. The subject wakes with partial recall. Observe overnight in the infirmary, bed 4.

Not to be issued without the Principal Investigator's signature.
footer: Last signed out: Dr. M. Varma. Reason given: "S-07. In case."

title: SUBJECT ARCHIVE · S-07
body:
One tape per cycle. Review, then erase and reuse.

Cycles 1–11: subject recalls the tank and confesses under induction. Not accepted. Not awake.
Cycle 12: subject asks for a full wipe. Granted.
Cycles 13–40: no recall of motive.

Exception: TAPE 12. Do not erase.
footer: Initialled M.V. Tape 12 is still in the deck.
